description: This file defines the Alignment class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for handling cell alignment styles such as horizontal and vertical alignments, text rotation, wrapping, and indentations for spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: Alignment
classes.description: Represents cell alignment styles with properties and methods to get/set horizontal and vertical alignment, text rotation, wrapping, indentation, and read order. Extends Supervisor to support style supervision within the spreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Alignment, initializes properties and parent class. Sets properties to null if created as a conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared alignment component for the current style, used when the style is a supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from alignment properties.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an input array to the Alignment object, updates properties or applies styles directly if supervisor.

methods.name: getHorizontal
methods.description: Returns the current horizontal alignment setting.

methods.name: setHorizontal
methods.description: Sets horizontal alignment; supports special handling for 'centercontinuous' and applies styles if supervisor.

methods.name: getVertical
methods.description: Returns the current vertical alignment setting.

methods.name: setVertical
methods.description: Sets vertical alignment and applies style if supervisor.

methods.name: getTextRotation
methods.description: Returns the text rotation angle.

methods.name: setTextRotation
methods.description: Sets the text rotation angle, allowing values between -90 and 90, with special handling for Excel's stack value.

methods.name: getWrapText
methods.description: Returns whether text wrapping is enabled.

methods.name: setWrapText
methods.description: Enables or disables text wrapping and applies style if supervisor.

methods.name: getShrinkToFit
methods.description: Returns whether shrink to fit is enabled.

methods.name: setShrinkToFit
methods.description: Enables or disables shrink to fit and applies style if supervisor.

methods.name: getIndent
methods.description: Returns the current indent level.

methods.name: setIndent
methods.description: Sets the indent level, with validation based on current horizontal alignment, and applies style if supervisor.

methods.name: getReadOrder
methods.description: Returns the current read order.

methods.name: setReadOrder
methods.description: Sets the reading order (LTR or RTL) with bounds checking and applies style if supervisor.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current style state for comparison or caching.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports the current alignment properties as an array for external use.
